verdicts.label: FALSE
verdicts.what_is_true_en: Drinking hot water with lemon juice does not prevent or cure COVID-19. Health organizations and experts have confirmed this is a false remedy with no effect on the coronavirus.
verdicts.reasoning_en: Multiple TIER_1 fact-checking organizations, including AP News, FactCheck.org, and AFP Fact Check, have debunked the claim that drinking hot water with lemon can cure or prevent COVID-19. Expert bodies like the National Academies also confirm that acidic drinks have no effect on coronavirus infections. The evidence is unanimous in stating this is a false remedy.
